title: Nimble Light Algerian Gherkin Tagine
description: A cultured and glassy-jelly light Algerian dish featuring gherkin relish, this tagine is perfect for a unique dinner experience. It is prepared using sous-vide and is FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, puree the sliced gherkin, olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger until smooth.
In a bowl, mix together the cumin, coriander, chicken broth, and lemon juice.
Combine the gherkin puree and the spice mixture in a sous-vide bag.
Seal the bag and cook for 2 hours.
Remove the bag from the sous-vide machine and let it cool.
Strain the tagine through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl.
Discard the solids and serve the tagine hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
